gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Dark and jagged, Eater lets its thin strokes sprawl across wide gaps between letters. Noto Sans Thai Looped follows in a sans-serif with tall, bold-looking lowercase, so paragraphs feel sturdy and clean.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-thai: Flavors goes whimsical and heavy, its diagonals as hefty as its stems and its lowercase towering up. Noto Sans Thai is the approachable counterpart, with puffy rounded letters left open, a plain sans that never fights for attention.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Autour One swells into bold, expressive shapes where every round letter has a clear channel leading in and no stroke ever thins out. Noto Sans Tifinagh is the plain sans partner, its inflated lowercase bowls staying open and inviting.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide spaces its glyphs wide and keeps its outline steady. Noto Sans Chorasmian does the quieter job, with a large x-height and curves that stop short instead of closing, which suits text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sofia-sans: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, with tips that never creep toward touching. Sofia Sans stands tall beside it, modern and unmodulated.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-sen: Wide, bold, and commanding, Goldman spreads its letters out with round forms like open parentheses. Sen brings a plain sans with tall lowercase and curves that end before turning inward, so a tiny Goldman heading would lose its sweep next to it.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sintony: Sintony reads smooth and contemporary, its chunky tall midzone keeping every curve clear of clogging. Grandstander above it is cut like laser sheet in one stroke width, so a long page moves easily.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sofia-sans-semi-condensed: Gugi's tall lowercase nearly reaches its capitals, and its terminals are cut open so the counters flow outward. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed, a plain sans, echoes that height with a stencil-like constant weight and a visible entrance into each curve.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-bespoke-sans: Commanding from the first word, Paprika scatters its letters at a distance and lets its lowercase fill the line like capitals. And Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined, leaving generous space between curve ends and the stem.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee has a thickness like neon glass tubing, with terminals that finish well clear of the stem and a mean line set high. Paprika's scattered, commanding lowercase gives it contrast.
